name: Terrestrial Laser Scanner
description: Tripod-mounted LiDAR scanner for high-accuracy 3D capture of bridges, buildings, and construction sites.

name: Mobile Mapping System
description: Vehicle-mounted LiDAR with cameras and GNSS/IMU for capturing roads and bridge decks at traffic speed.

name: Handheld SLAM Scanner
description: Walk-through scanner for fast capture of interiors, tunnels, and tight spaces where a tripod is impractical.

name: UAV LiDAR System
description: Drone-mounted LiDAR for corridor mapping, terrain models, and structures that are hard to reach from the ground.

name: Photogrammetry Drone
description: RTK-enabled camera drone for orthomosaics, surface models, and weekly progress surveys.

name: GNSS RTK Receivers
description: Base and rover receivers for establishing control points and georeferencing scan and drone data.

name: Robotic Total Station
description: High-precision angle and distance measurement for control networks and deformation monitoring.

name: GPU Processing Workstations
description: High-memory workstations for point cloud registration, photogrammetry, and training deep learning models.
